title: Ciphertext-only high-moduli residue balance prior
rationale: This lane predeclares a ciphertext-only high-moduli residue rule before scoring any new observations. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery uses only K4 ciphertext positions modulo 7 through 13 and excludes known public anchor-derived plaintext spans, additive fragment values, key-material candidates, route searches, and held-out anchor controls.
prediction_target: Future source-reviewed non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in the predeclared high-moduli ciphertext-only residue-balance position sets before any candidate-word, key-material, route, or public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Public K4 ciphertext characters and one-based ciphertext positions only
Predeclared residue-balance rule over moduli 7 through 13, with known solved clue positions used only as an exclusion mask
No public known-plaintext anchor fragments, additive-key values, candidate words, key-material offsets, or route/permutation results
evaluation_inputs: Future source-reviewed non-anchor K4 position observations selected before scoring
Observation files with per-position source notes and validation against the registered non-anchor universe
Independent target positions that are not public known-plaintext anchor fragments and are not derived from anchor additive-key values
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position-shuffle baseline for residue-set enrichment
best-of-modulus null control over the predeclared 7 through 13 modulus range
multiple-comparison correction across all preregistered independent lanes before interpretation
source-review and source-archive gates before observation scoring
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
